description: The frozen data roles of the thesis. Members are '<acquisition_set>:part_<n>'. The four roles follow from the calibration/held-out partition of calibration_contract.json and the volumetric energy density window; dataset_split.py checks that derivation against this file, which is authoritative.

notes.calibration: Nine coupons inside the window; used for the search, the confirmation candidates and the selection freeze.
notes.in_window_held_out: Five held-out coupons inside the window; read only by the evaluation stage, after the selection freeze.
notes.out_of_window_examined: Seven calibration-partition coupons outside the window; already examined by the camera diagnostic before the calibration.
notes.out_of_window_blind: Three held-out coupons outside the window; never read before the evaluation stage.
notes.cross_campaign_held_out: The one in-window held-out coupon from the September acquisition campaign (different synchronization convention).
